target_customer: Developers and AI teams building financial research agents, plus investors using agent tools
problem: Agents need accurate, structured, real time stock market data, but market data was built for people reading screens and was hard to wire into agents.
business_model: Usage and subscription priced API for market data, with REST, MCP server and webhooks
product_category: Financial data API and search infrastructure for AI agents

founders.name: Virat Singh
founders.background_notes: Tech lead on search recommendations at Faire, started in buy side M&A, built open source finance agents (ai-hedge-fund, Dexter) that carry large GitHub star counts per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Parsing and normalizing SEC filings into accurate structured data at scale is standard but laborious engineering, with accuracy and latency as the hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Underlying filings are public and many vendors sell similar data; the edge is accuracy, agent friendly access and distribution through the founder's open source projects.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: By late 2026 Bloomberg, Massive and others had launched MCP access for AI agents, so incumbents moved into the wedge after founding.

market_need_then: Building agents on market data was a visible pain for the founder, who started the company after being frustrated getting quality real time data for his own agents. Demand evidence is the company's claim of 1,000 plus customers, unverified.

identity.logo: Wordmark only in light and dark versions, details not visible
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct and technical, emphasizing accuracy and benchmarks.

branding.brand_signature: Open source agent repos (ai-hedge-fund, Dexter) that depend on its API
branding.community_and_virality: Founder's open source projects reportedly reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars each, per the YC page and third party summaries; counts not verified on GitHub.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is generic, but the founder's open source repos act as a distribution and credibility engine for the product.

outcome_analysis: Financial Datasets is an active one person company in the Summer 2026 batch, with the product live since about 2024 and an MCP server launched in 2025. Traction claims and funding are unverified. The open source repos give it unusual distribution, while competitors including Bloomberg and Massive have since added agent access, so the risk is commoditization.
notes: Unverified funding: VCBacked reports $500K pre-seed from YC dated 2026-09; Dealroom shows a $125K seed. Both are aggregators and conflict, so no round recorded. Competitor sources found were all 2025 and 2026, so the founding era list is empty. Competitors that emerged later: Bloomberg Enterprise MCP (2026-09), Massive MCP, Eulerpool MCP (2026-02). Completeness pass: Round rests on a single database (VCBacked); Dealroom shows a conflicting 125K seed, not recorded.
